description: This file defines the ArgParser class, a utility for parsing command line arguments in a Java application. It provides methods for retrieving flags and associated data sequentially from an argument list.

classes.name: ArgParser
classes.description: A helper class for parsing command line arguments, supporting the retrieval of flags and data, and tracking position within the argument list.

methods.name: ArgParser
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser with an array of command line arguments.

methods.name: nextFlag
methods.description: Returns the next argument starting with '--' as a flag, advancing the position, or null if no such flag exists.

methods.name: hasData
methods.description: Checks if the upcoming 'count' arguments are available and are not flags, starting from the current position.

methods.name: nextData
methods.description: Retrieves the next argument as data, advancing the position, or returns null if no data is available.

methods.name: remaining
methods.description: Returns the number of arguments remaining to be processed.

methods.name: pos
methods.description: Returns the current position index within the argument array.
